Careers

Come help us prepare for how AI will change humanity and help nudge us toward more positive futures.
Astera Benefits
We want to ensure you can thrive at Astera

Benefits include:

  • Top tier health insurance plans with 99% of premiums covered by Astera for employees and dependents
  • Daily lunch that brings the full office together, plus a well-stocked fridge and pantry
  • Licenses for frontier AI tools and software
  • 403(b) retirement plans, paid time off, paid parental leave, commuter benefits, and Health and Dependent Care FSAs

We are an equal opportunity employer and are invested in fostering a culture where everyone can thrive. We are committed to equity and inclusion, and we encourage women, people of color, LGBTQIA individuals, people with disabilities, members of ethnic minorities, foreign-born residents, older members of society, and others from minority communities and diverse backgrounds to apply.
